description:
The monster fills its entire space and is transparent. Other creatures can enter that space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the monster's Engulf and has Disadvantage on the saving throw.

Creatures inside the monster have &Reference[Total Cover], and the monster can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or Small creatures inside itself at a time.

As an action, a creature within [[lookup @range.value activity=EcTOfXWsDJRHLydy]] [[lookup @range.units activity=EcTOfXWsDJRHLydy]]. of the monster can pull a creature or an object out of the monster by succeeding on a [[/check dc=12 ability=str skill=ath format=long]], and the puller takes [[/damage average activity=PMCvyqxfUYiPzNK8]] damage.
name: Ooze Cube
